2. (1) The Board shall meet at least once a year at such place as may

(2) At any meeting of the Board the President shall preside, and
in his absence the members shall elect one of their number to preside
over the meeting.

3, (1) The Board shall have a common seal which shall bear such

(2) Until a seal is provided by the |Board under this paragraph, a

(3) The Common Seal shall be kept! in the custody of the President

4. All monies arising from fees payable| under this Act shall be paid to

registration and other expenses of the administration of this Act includ-
